title: 09. Production & Safety: Rate Limiting & Throttling
summary: Rate limiting controls how many requests a user/service can make in a time window. Without it, one misbehaving client can exhaust your API quota, causing everyone to experience failures.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Rate limiting controls **how many requests** a user/service can make in a time window. Without it, one misbehaving client can exhaust your API quota, causing **everyone** to experience failures.

sections.title: Rate Limiting Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              RATE LIMITING — WHY IT MATTERS                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  WITHOUT RATE LIMITING:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Normal traffic:   100 req/min ✅
  Bot attack at 9AM: 10,000 req/min
  Your OpenAI quota: exhausted in 60 seconds
  All 10,000 normal users at 9:01AM: "Service unavailable" ❌

  WITH RATE LIMITING:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Per-user limit:   10 req/min
  Bot sends 10,000: blocked after 10 requests → 429 Too Many Requests
  Normal users:     Unaffected ✅

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  RATE LIMIT STRATEGIES:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  STRATEGY 1: Fixed Window
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Allow 100 requests per minute.
  Window resets every 60 seconds.

  Minute 1:  [██████████████] 100/100 → 101st request: BLOCKED
  Minute 2:  [               ] 0/100  → fresh window starts

  Problem: Burst at window boundary
  (100 requests at :59, 100 at :00 = 200 in 2 seconds)

  STRATEGY 2: Sliding Window (better)
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Count requests in the LAST 60 seconds (rolling).
  Always smooth — no boundary burst possible.

  STRATEGY 3: Token Bucket (best for AI agents)
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Bucket fills at 10 tokens/second. Max capacity: 100 tokens.
  Each request consumes tokens based on complexity.

  Simple query:  1 token
  Complex query: 5 tokens
  Heavy analysis: 20 tokens

  Benefits: Allows controlled bursts, proportional to work done.

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  LAYERED RATE LIMITS (production):
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Layer 1: Per user:         10 requests/minute
  Layer 2: Per API key:     100 requests/minute
  Layer 3: Per service:    1000 requests/minute
  Layer 4: OpenAI quota: 90,000 TPM (tokens per minute)

  All layers protect each other!
```
